Officer's narrative
On the afternoon of the reported incident, I responded to a parking lot in Katy, Texas, where a two-vehicle collision
had been reported at low speed. Driver 1 was reportedly backing out of a space when the rear of the vehicle struck
the front quarter of a vehicle driven by Driver 2. Passenger was seated in Driver 1's vehicle at the time. Officers on
scene and people present in the lot confirmed that Passenger and Driver 1 were in the vehicle when it moved. No
independent witness saw the impact itself. Driver 1 reported a concussion with headache and dizziness, which is
consistent with the forces expected in a collision of this type. Photographs taken at the scene show damage to both
vehicles that lines up with the described contact point, and I found no indication of earlier damage to either vehicle.
Dirver 1 is listed as the named insured on the policy covering the vehicle. Drvier 2 reported no injuries. Both drivers
exchanged information, and a copy of the scene photographs has been placed in the case file.
